unit.label: -hood
unit.core_meaning: a state, condition or group sharing one
unit.mentor_note: Hood turns a person into a period or a condition: child into childhood, widow into widowhood. It is abstract, and abstraction is exactly what a summary question is testing.

members.meaning: an alliance, or the state of being brothers
the state of being a widow
an untruth; the state of being false

predict_options.text: The state or condition of being something
A place where something is kept

discovery.understand_note: Hood makes a condition out of a thing: likely gives likelihood, widow gives widowhood. It is one of the quiet ways English turns a concrete noun into an abstract one.

applies.prompt: Knowing -hood means the state of being something, what is a falsehood?

options.text: An untruth — something in a state of being false
A disguise worn over the head
A mistake made in good faith
